inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: They’re presenting it as routine border policy, but the timing after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, looks deliberate. The language about “strengthening” the system seems to be cover for a coordinated clampdown targeting Nigerians and others, while those who benefit remain out of sight.
